content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 establishes that CPT 93271 is bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable; a clean resubmission would risk a duplicate denial, and no current denial supports another appeal or peer-to-peer request. Because this contractual denial creates no proper patient liability and there is no secondary payer, the remaining balance is not collectible despite similar claims showing patient payments.","action":"write_off"}
